verdict.rationale: Ramp MCP documents conversational policy answers for employees inside their daily tools, which covers "can I expense this?". For missing receipts, Ramp sends automated reminders and its CLI and agent tooling expose missing-item flagging and explanation. Pre-spend policy enforcement is documented, but no evidence shows the assistant explaining card declines conversationally. Missing for 10: documented conversational explanation of declines, evidence that the assistant itself proactively chases receipts in conversation (beyond an example prompt and generic reminders), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens
